endpoints.name: PTree.Examples.PGCL.FreeOmega.pgcl_while_least_prefixed
endpoints.type:
@FreeOmega.pgcl_while_least_prefixed
     : forall (S P : Type) (MN : Type -> Type) (NI : Measure.SemanticMeasure MN)
         (NC : @Measure.SemanticMeasureCoreLaws MN NI) (NO : @Omega.SemanticOmega MN NI)
         (coin : P -> MN bool) (b : S -> bool) (c : Syntax.command S P)
         (Y : S -> Definition.FreeOmega MN S),
       (forall s : S,
        @DomainOrder.free_omega_sem_le MN NI NO S
          (if b s
           then
            @Measure.sem_bind (Definition.FreeOmega MN)
              (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasure MN NI NO) S S
              (@Forward.denote S P MN (Definition.FreeOmega MN)
                 (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasure MN NI NO)
                 (@StructuralMeasure.FreeOmegaMixedMeasure MN)
                 (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticOmega MN NI NO)
                 (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasureOrderLaws MN NI NC NO)
                 (@BindOrder.FreeOmegaObservableOmegaSelection MN NI NC NO) coin c s) Y
           else
            @Measure.sem_ret (Definition.FreeOmega MN)
              (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasure MN NI NO) S s)
          (Y s)) ->
       forall s : S,
       @DomainOrder.free_omega_sem_le MN NI NO S
         (@Forward.denote S P MN (Definition.FreeOmega MN)
            (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasure MN NI NO)
            (@StructuralMeasure.FreeOmegaMixedMeasure MN)
            (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticOmega MN NI NO)
            (@Measure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasureOrderLaws MN NI NC NO)
            (@BindOrder.FreeOmegaObservableOmegaSelection MN NI NC NO) coin
            (@Syntax.CWhile S P b c) s) (Y s)
